name: All Lava The Floor!
author: Zantetsuken88
description: A hot mess - literally. This game is but a shadow of what I was hoping - the tutorial had a very simple scope since I am a Unity beginner, however my ambitions ran away with me. I wanted a rollercoaster, a trailing camera, a flaming archway. I wanted gravity-defying stunts. I wanted these things without understanding fundamental Unity concepts and I wasted an inordinate amount of time trying and ~mostly~ failing to create them. In the end I was forced to accept that I wasn't ready to bring to my lofty ideas to life. I did however, manage the flaming archway.
